name: studyflow-local-web
description: Mobile-first, self-contained StudyFlow Local web application.

scripts.build: python3 scripts/validate_web.py --all && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false && node scripts/compile_runtime.mjs && node scripts/build_dist.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/compile_runtime.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.lint: python3 scripts/validate_web.py --all && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false && node scripts/compile_runtime.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist
